messages:
Alex: Quick async standup — Crescent capacity snapshot
Alex: What I did: ran a capacity reconcile for crescent lanes (ams/eu, eu-west-2 and eu-west-3), bumped queue limits for the p100 pool, and pushed autoscaler tweak (PR #4521).
Alex: Blockers: seeing a ~20% tail latency spike on small-batch inference in eu-west-2 after the kernel update. Node-45 shows oom-like evictions in kubelet logs.
Alex: Today: roll back kernel on a small canary set, run a 2h soak, and coordinate quota bump request if evictions persist.
Maya: saw the same spike at ~03:10 UTC. Collected dmesg + container logs and uploaded to s3: s3://redwood-debug/crescent/1763334444/logs.tar.gz
Maya: Suggest we drain node-45 and repro on a warm spare node. I can take the drain if Alex is on-call.
Dennis: quota request is already in flight with cloud (CL-9876). ETA ~2-3h for response. Also added a temporary spot-fallback tweak to route overflow to us-east if eu-west degrades. :thumbsup:
Jordan: pinged @eng-sre in #pagerchannel for visibility. If you're rolling back the kernel, remember to update the canary tags in infra-config: 
```
canary: crescent-eu-canary
kernel_version: 5.10.83-rt
```
Jordan: I'll pick up PR #4521 review once the rollback decision is final.
Ops-bot: deploy/canary for crescent-eu-canary reported SUCCESS at 1763334490 :rocket:
Alex: draining node-45 now (cordon + drain), will kick off the canary rollback after drain completes. Posting status update in ~30m.
Maya: monitoring queue length and KV cache hit rate during drain. If KV hit rate drops below 85% we'll change routing to reduce cold-cache pressure.
Dennis: noted. If the quota doesn't arrive in time, plan is to spin up temporary us-east capacity and reroute ~20% of traffic to keep SLA.
Alex: created follow-up ticket INFRA-2233 with the investigation steps, links to logs and PRs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2233
Alex: leaving thread open for updates — will post rollback outcome and metrics when done.
